name: @sos-2/worker-runtime
description: SOS 2.0 Worker Runtime (Work Order P6): the contract a WORKER fulfils while executing an assigned task through the P5 harness. The runtime consumes @sos-2/harness operations (createTask/resumeTask/pauseTask/cancelTask and the workspace/shell/browser/git/artifacts/observations surfaces) through the merged execution fabric's uniform gate pipeline (task -> lease -> authority -> advertisement -> dispatch), acquires its body through @sos-2/body-broker leases, and makes CAPABILITY-CHECKED calls: an unadvertised operation is a typed UNSUPPORTED consumed from the contract's own binding advertisement map (isOperationAdvertised) — never a silent failure. CHECKPOINT DISCIPLINE: periodic durable checkpoints (progress + artifact refs) recorded through the fabric's recordCheckpoint and chained into the durable task graph, so a crashed worker RESUMES FROM CHECKPOINT, not from zero (pinned by tests). RESULT EMISSION: typed WorkerResult records carrying evidence refs (durable observation ids + content-addressed artifact ids — never fabricated), the EXACT workspace revision, provenance (provider identity + model + version when the reasoning broker participated) and an HONEST status — a worker reporting completion NEVER certifies mission success (section 10): the orchestrator routes every completion report to independent verification. The reference implementation is a deterministic in-process worker driven by injected ports (clock, fabric, broker, stores) — ZERO real process spawning in library code; simulated crashes are explicit, deterministic injections. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env in this package's src — everything is injected.
